description: M05-U10 case index (m05-plan §3 "Exit mapping"): every M05 exit case and claim mapped to its Cargo test targets and tests, per platform, in the M02 format (tests/native/m02/case-index.json description; read by tests/native/m05/m05-evidence.py, which is m02-evidence.py with the M05 constants, as m03-evidence.py is for M03). Patterns resolve into required-inventory.json from the build host's sources, never from run logs. Owner-input rows are blocked_rows naming m05-plan §7's B-IDs (B2, B7, B9, B12); rows that M04's exit closes (plan Q9) are deferred_with_decision. The wsl-distro platform runs the scenario target wsl_hook_m05 (tests/native/m05/wsl-hook-journeys.sh). G05 is not a group here: tests/evidence/m05-g05-agent-context.json is the hand-written gate record, and the exit claim cites it.

heimdall_testkit-unit::repo::tests::unse.reason: asserts that the compile-time repository root (the build host's checkout) holds Cargo.toml and schemas/, which exists only where the binary was built; the HM_REPO_ROOT resolution it covers is platform-neutral and its sibling tests run everywhere

heimdall_runtime-unit::managed_store::li.rationale: #[cfg(all(test, unix))] mod live_tests (crates/runtime/src/managed_store.rs): the in-process live journeys bind a real Unix-socket endpoint in a scratch runtime directory and run the system ssh against a disposable loopback sshd; native Windows has no Unix-socket endpoint, and the Windows rows of A02, A04, A16 and A28 are the exit suite's (e2e_exit_m05, ruling I-16)

e2e_cli_m05::hook_never_evaluates_reposi.rationale: #[cfg(unix)] (tests/e2e/cli_m05.rs): the journey drives the real binary on a pseudo-terminal through script(1) (`Pty`, `run_pty`) for the typed `yes` and the interactive shells, and the file has no Windows pseudoconsole driver; native Windows has no shell integration (owner question Q6), and the Windows rows of these claims are the exit suite's (e2e_exit_m05, ruling I-16)

e2e_cli_m05::workspace_paths_are_quoted_.rationale: #[cfg(unix)] (tests/e2e/cli_m05.rs): the checkout's directory name holds a line break, which a Windows file system refuses, and the journey runs the real binary through the Unix harness; the rendering rule is also covered by the platform-neutral unit test m05_cmd::tests::workspace_paths_render_as_quoted_data

e2e_hook_m05::hook_warms_the_default_so_.rationale: #[cfg(unix)] (tests/e2e/m05_hook.rs): a loopback sshd and Unix sockets through exit_m03's world; native Windows has no shell integration (owner question Q6), so the hook's warm-up has no Windows form (ordinary-ssh activation there is the exit suite's)

e2e_hook_m05::hook_warm_up_creates_no_de.rationale: #[cfg(unix)] (tests/e2e/m05_hook.rs): a loopback sshd and Unix sockets through exit_m03's world; native Windows has no shell integration (owner question Q6), so the hook's warm-up has no Windows form

e2e_delegation_m05::run_parent_binding_g.rationale: #[cfg(unix)] (tests/e2e/m05_delegation.rs): two loopback sshds and Unix sockets; the Windows harness serves one account-form server per test thread, so the scope refusal has no second server there (the file's header records the rows as blocked on Windows)

e2e_delegation_m05::wider_or_longer_requ.rationale: #[cfg(unix)] (tests/e2e/m05_delegation.rs): two loopback sshds and Unix sockets; the Windows harness serves one account-form server per test thread (the file's header records the rows as blocked on Windows)

integration_ipc_unix.rationale: #![cfg(unix)] (tests/integration/ipc_unix.rs): Unix domain sockets and peer-uid checks; the target builds with zero tests on Windows, whose named-pipe equivalents are heimdall_ipc-unit's windows:: tests (this group's platform_required for Windows)

integration_runtime::instance_insecure_f.rationale: Tests POSIX modes and symlinks (#[cfg(unix)]). On Windows the state directory relies on the per-user %LOCALAPPDATA% ACL; M01 makes no Windows claim that the state directory is owner-only, and an explicit Windows ACL check with a native test is an M04 item (ADR-0006 §13.12 item 4).

integration_runtime::paths_tighten_exist.rationale: Tests POSIX modes and symlinks (#[cfg(unix)]). On Windows the state directory relies on the per-user %LOCALAPPDATA% ACL; M01 makes no Windows claim that the state directory is owner-only, and an explicit Windows ACL check with a native test is an M04 item (ADR-0006 §13.12 item 4).

adversarial_prompt_injection_cli::a29_cl.rationale: Unix only (script(1) pseudo-terminal for the owner's typed `yes`; tests/adversarial/prompt_injection/cli.rs): the file has no Windows pty driver, and the non-terminal refusals of the same references run on every platform in a29_cli_decide_without_a_terminal_is_interaction_required
Unix only (a FIFO bundle, made with mkfifo(3), which Windows does not have; finding A29-F1, fixed in W4: `import` refuses it at once)
Unix only (real bash and zsh; the shell integration is Unix-only, owner question Q6; finding A29-F2, fixed in W4: the script checks its own state variables before use)
